text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I peeked into the studio—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm..., I want something with a bit more 
punch... Like, BAM-BAM-BOOM!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì. Then let's play it forzando... How is 
this?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Yes, exactly, looking good! Match 
the melody, like this!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're working hard at your 
dance lessons.

Looks like you're working hard at your 
dance lessons, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Ahaha, I guess it really does 
look like dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we were talking about manga! 
About how to make the manga I'm drawing 
right now even more interesting!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a passionate conversation... My 
heart feels so utterly fulfilled right 
now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Still, to an outsider, it looked like 
nothing more than dancing along to the 
music. Just what kind of manga is she 
drawing...?”

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that look on your face! If you're 
curious... go ahead! Please, give it a 
read!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I've finally caught up to you. Let's 
settle once and for all who the true 
"Dance King" is!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Can you keep up with these steps— 
'Creative Beat'!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Heh, let us revel in it. This fleeting 
banquet— "Risonanza dell'Anima"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Creative choreography and vibrant 
characters. Though unpolished, there's 
something truly captivating about it...!
choice_data_list: I want to read more of this manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Really? We did it! It's all thanks to you, 
Earth-chan~!
choice_data_list: What do you mean, thanks to her?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I realized something... Whenever 
I listen to Earth-chan's music, my body 
just moves on its own!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie a te. I too am finding inspiration 
in you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Those steps born from your artistic 
sensibility! How utterly con fuoco they 
are!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the music won't stop playing in my 
heart...! Come on, let's keep the jam 
session going!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, leave it to me! The more I dance, 
the more interesting my manga gets...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep dancing until I surpass my 
limits!
choice_data_list:
Come to think of it, I feel like your 
dancing has improved, too...

The live show's gonna be as flashy as a 
manga!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh... R-Really? Now that you mention it, 
maybe I have gotten better at doing those 
difficult steps...
choice_data_list:
Maybe this is the result of all that 
dancing!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it's because you danced a lot 
for the manga! ...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The more interesting the manga gets, the 
better my dancing becomes...! It's truly a 
fusion of reality and fiction!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then there's not a single reason to 
hesitate... Let us play our symphony 
together!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, totally! If we incorporate 
choreography born from this session, the 
live performance would be packed with 
impact... !?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then show me... your soul-stirring 
steps!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right! Surrender your heart to the 
music――here we go!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Now, let your passion guide you...! 'Wild 
Dance Dyed in Crimson'!"
